title: Anchored Hilbert Cube reconnaissance
operator_override: Continue digging while substantive new mathematics is produced. Stop only when successive work merely renames/repackages the same unresolved point, when no concrete new reduction remains, or when an external theorem wall is deliberately frozen for Work.
next_attack_if_audit_passes: Use the nearly-coprime factorization (M-N)(M+N)=|A|/g together with MN=(8/g)|a^3b^3(a^2-b^2)| and the cube-exponent allocation. Continue only if this yields a genuine descent, finite cover reduction, rational-point statement, or new local obstruction; merely restating the genus-7 curve or increasing finite search bounds is not progress.
substantive_progress_requires_one_of: new proved identity or rational-point statement
new exact curve/cover/reduction or local obstruction
removal or strict narrowing of a genuine boundary component
strictly enlarged proved coverage of anchored cubes
new necessary condition for arbitrary anchored cubes
exact adapter to an already-proved theorem
firewalls: No family-specific exclusion implies perfect-cuboid nonexistence.
Equation (6) is not universal; A1-3 proves only a one-dimensional anchor boundary inside a full anchored algebraic variety with components of dimension at least two.
Positive rank of the genus-1 quotient does not imply a surviving point through the reconstruction covers.
The height-5000 search is finite evidence only, not a rational-point theorem.
The A1-5 primitive-Pythagorean descent is family-specific and does not apply to arbitrary perfect cuboids.
The local sieve p=3,5,7,23 is family-specific.
Stage27 and StructureRadar receivers remain unchanged.
Do not count renamed equations, equivalent repackaging, or repeated finite searches without a changed mathematical receiver as substantive progress.
